result: Passed independent source-witness, original-model score, selected-geometry domain and earlier-mask exhaustive checks. The README singleton-count typo was corrected before this review was frozen.

review_scope.family: One frozen heuristic completion of the recorded CHI-Nov13 partial square and fixed column order; exactly five losses from a 170-coordinate frame preserving all 165 received coordinates.
review_scope.exact_engine: The engine source hash is unchanged from the independently reviewed synthetic six-gram calibration. Its coverage, state representation, prefix dominance and canonical tie arguments carry over to this input.

independent_methods.model_scores: Read all nonempty sparse six-gram entries into a separate Python dictionary without reusing the engine lookup. Read four-gram float32 values directly by byte offset. Convert every used value to exact integer units through its rational numerator and denominator.
independent_methods.cipher_arithmetic: Explicit column lengths and start offsets for inverse transposition and a separate forward column traversal for re-encryption; no repository cipher or optimizer module imported.
independent_methods.partial_domains: Enumerate coordinate-pair cells consistent with each observed half-coordinate; unassigned cells admit every still-unused alphabet symbol. Compare all 85 per-position domains with the report, retaining their global square-assignment dependence.
independent_methods.old_mask_check: Enumerate all 6^5 coordinate-fill vectors under the earlier four-gram loss mask, decode each and compute its original six-gram score; break equal scores lexically by the complete plaintext to match the finite-domain comparison.

earlier_mask_comparison.conclusion: At this fixed key, refilling the earlier four-gram mask cannot attain the new score. The strictly better six-gram score therefore requires a different loss geometry.

presentation_review: The full model-selected text is printed without promoting isolated readable substrings.
The supplied historical square contains fourteen heuristic labels, unlike the supplied true square in the positive synthetic calibration.
The singleton counts are explicitly conditional on the selected geometry and are not counted as newly recovered letters.
The comparison table is a rescoring of two feasible candidates; no full historical mixed-objective search is claimed.
The report distinguishes an exact conditional language optimum from a historically authenticated key, damage model or plaintext.
The initial README count of eighty complete-key singleton positions was corrected to eighty-one. The five gaps affect only four pairs: indices 32,35,36,41.
limits: The entire full-space optimization was not repeated by this independent review; its unchanged reviewed engine and complete run record support the exactness claim, while independent checks establish the winner score and feasibility.
The result does not optimize or bound other completions of the partial square, other column orders, other numbers of losses, or coordinate substitutions.
Even the 48 singleton positions under the recorded partial square depend on the selected geometry. They are not fixed throughout the unrestricted loss family.
No historical p198 plaintext is accepted from this experiment or review.
